name: neotoma-marketplace
description: Neotoma plugins for Claude. Shares the marketplace name neotoma-marketplace with the package-local catalog on purpose: both list the same plugin, so the install id is neotoma@neotoma-marketplace from either source.

plugins.name: neotoma
plugins.description: Connect Claude to Neotoma (Claude Code: your own Neotoma or the public sandbox; Chat and Cowork: see the setup skill), with setup, check, and recover skills and starter commands.
